children.counts: Simple 1-2 walking counts matching the slow musical strum.
children.game_version: A follow-the-leader circle game where children practice matching steps along a round pathway while repeating call-and-response vocal verses.

avoid: Uneven outdoor ground that challenges balance
seniors.counts: Slow steady steps aligned to the natural pulse of the sung verses.
seniors.seated_version: Performers sit in a circle, singing the folk melodies and gently tapping their feet or swaying the upper body in time with the dramnyen strumming.
seniors.standing_version: Participants move in a slow, supported circle, taking gentle steps along the circular floor track while singing.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintained at an unhurried, gentle walking tempo with small, comfortable steps.

movement_profile.footwork: Slow progression moving in a line or circle (circulus)
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group arrangement in a line or a circle (circulus)
movement_profile.partnering: Communal group dancing with both men and women participating together

music_profile.musical_form: Traditional folk song verses accompanied by instrumental lute
music_profile.sound_description: The sonic texture is defined by collective choral folk singing delivered directly by the dancers as they step. Melodic and rhythmic foundation is provided by the plucked strings of the traditional dramnyen lute, creating a steady, deliberate Himalayan folk soundscape.
music_profile.vocal_style: Traditional folk songs sung communally by the dancers

basic_steps: Gather in a communal line or circular formation alongside other participants
Engage in traditional folk singing while maintaining position in the group
Step slowly along the line or circulus in coordination with the vocal song and dramnyen accompaniment
teaching.level_notes: Beginners join the collective line or circle, matching the slow walking progression and joining the communal vocal singing.
teaching.rhythm: Slow tempo aligned with traditional folk songs and dramnyen accompaniment
